Name: Cyclops Farmer
Author: ZeiaZeh
Description:
Replaces vanilla farmer base file with a cyclops girl (or boy) to satisfy your monster needs!

Choose either with or without nose version, with nose currently unavailable for male. [size=1]Personally I think the noseless looks best...

[/size]Male and skirt versions in progress!

Mini skirt mod can be found here: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/216/?]Mini Skirt and Low Cut Top Mod[/url]

More information can be found here: [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/cyclops-farmer-girl-mod.112066/]Chucklefish Forums Cyclops Farmer Girl[/url]

Downloads.Description: Contains both with and without nose file. (vanilla base)
